documents.text:
Carol R. Gosain
202 429 6461
cgosain@steptoe.com

1330 Connecticut Avenue, NW
Washington, DC 20036-1795
202 429 3000 main
www.steptoe.com




                                                   October 2, 2026

Via e-Filing
The Honorable Debbie-Anne A. Reese, Secretary
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
888 First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20426

        Re:        GSP Newington, LLC, et al.,
                   Response to Deficiency Letter (Public and Confidential Workpapers)
                   Docket No. EC26-166

Dear Secretary Reese:

       On October 1, 2026 Applicants submitted in Docket No. EC26-166 an Appendix A
analysis (including an affidavit of Julie R. Solomon and accompanying exhibits) in response to a
Commission deficiency letter (Submission ID: 1794742). Applicants hereby submit for filing the
workpapers supporting Ms. Solomon’s affidavit.

        Applicants request confidential treatment of the workpapers marked as confidential
(CUI//PRIV) pursuant to Sections 33.8, 388.112, 385.1112, and 388.107(d) of the Commission’s
regulations1 and exemption from the mandatory public disclosure requirements of the Freedom
of Information Act pursuant to Section 388.107(d) of the Commission’s regulations. 2 The
confidential information in the workpapers contains competitively sensitive information that is
not generally available to the public. Applicants have provided a proposed protective agreement
as Attachment 2 to the Application pursuant to which eligible parties will be able to obtain access
to the non-public materials. Any questions regarding this request for confidential treatment
should be addressed to counsel listed in Section VI.B of the Application.




        1
            18 C.F.R. §§ 33.8, 388.112, 385.1112 and 388.107(d).
        2
            Id. at. § 388.107(d); see also 5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(4) (2026).
 The Honorable Debbie-Anne A. Reese, Secretary
October 2, 2026
Page 2 of 2


       Thank you for your attention to this matter. Please do not hesitate to contact the
undersigned if you have any questions.

                                            Respectfully submitted,


                                            /s/ Carol Gosain

                                            Carol Gosain
                                            Steptoe LLP
                                            1330 Connecticut Avenue NW
                                            Washington, DC 20036
                                            (202) 429-6461
                                            cgosain@steptoe.com
